profile.org_note: Private, family-owned (founded 1972 by William J. Wolf); the parent is Maronda, Inc. and job postings are issued by 'Maronda Inc. and Subsidiaries'. Corporate office in Imperial, PA, a Florida regional office in Sanford, FL, and division offices under regional presidents and division presidents. Land runs through a land committee: a 2026 posting has Mid-Atlantic land reporting to a 'Regional VP of Land Operations' and an 'EVP of Land for the North Region', and Florida land directors reporting to a 'VP Land Acquisitions'; none of these holders is named publicly. The company publishes a land-opportunity inbox and phone line for each region on its contact page (for example web-land-jacksonville@maronda.com, 904-268-7730 ext. 3903; web-land-orlando@maronda.com, 407-302-7800 ext. 8868; web-land-virginia@maronda.com, 703-753-7020 ext. 3214; web-land-pittsburgh@maronda.com, 412-220-3082).
profile.summary: Private, Wolf-family-owned builder based near Pittsburgh, ranked 36th on the 2026 Builder 100, selling entry-level and move-up homes in 11 states with most of its volume in Florida. A 2026 job posting for its Florida regional president describes an 'asset/land lite philosophy' and tasks the role with finding land banking and third-party developers, so the company is an active user of outside land capital. Almost nothing about its leadership is published by the company itself; most names here come from directories and state filings and should be confirmed before a call.

gaps: Company publishes no leadership page; every named person here comes from third-party directories, a state-records mirror or older company blog posts, so none is tagged Verified.

CEO: not confirmed. Builder's 2026 Builder 100 firm profile reportedly lists Scott Howard as CEO, but that page returned 403 and was seen only in search snippets; other listings call him President or Executive VP, Corporate Growth.

Owner / chair: the company describes itself as family-owned (Wolf family, founder William J. Wolf); which family member currently chairs or controls Maronda, Inc. is not publicly stated. BBB still lists 'William Wolf, Owner' (undated).
CFO: not publicly disclosed. Christopher Ruddle reportedly held the CFO role 2020 to 2023 before becoming COO; no successor is named.
Treasurer / capital markets head: not publicly disclosed.
Head of land (corporate): not publicly disclosed. Job postings confirm an 'EVP of Land for the North Region', a 'Regional VP of Land Operations' and a Florida 'VP Land Acquisitions', but name no one.
Land acquisition names (Chris Stephens, Andrew Hall) were seen only in a search-result summary and could not be confirmed on any page opened.

Division presidents by market: not public. ZoomInfo lists three division presidents and two regional presidents without geography. Mid-Atlantic division president role was advertised January to March 2025 (reports to Regional President and/or COO) after the prior holder left; current holder not found. A 'Division President of Treasure Coast Region' posting was also seen in search results (page blocked).

Reporting lines are not published; the only stated ones come from job postings (Florida Regional President reports to the President of Florida/Georgia/Alabama; division presidents report to a regional president and/or the COO).
Email pattern: no personal email pattern published; only regional role inboxes at maronda.com.

Not opened: Builder firm profile (403), Florida Sunbiz (bot check), SEC EDGAR full-text search (403), Datanyze and Village profiles (403), Gulfshore Business, Jacksonville Chamber and ProPublica pages (fetch rate-limited).
